text_description: Full runway look cropped from head to above the knees, built in a coordinated pale grey and off-white newspaper-print fabric with scattered black text blocks and muted graphic panels. The outer layer is a long, straight, open-front coat with a softly structured silhouette, broad pointed collar trimmed in cream fuzzy shearling-like texture, long sleeves, and visible gold-tone buttons; the coat hangs past the visible skirt and shows a deep burgundy lining peeking from the lower opening. On one shoulder sits a dramatic dark grey and black feathered or shredded-textile embellishment, placed like an oversized corsage/epaulet. Under the coat is a matching collared jacket or shirt layer in the same print, buttoned with small gold-tone buttons and featuring a rectangular muted green-grey graphic patch across the chest, creating a stacked tonal collar effect beneath the fuzzy coat collar. The bottom is a close-fitting matching mini skirt in the same newspaper print, sitting high at the waist and ending above the knee with a slightly angled or wrap-like front edge. Styling is polished and layered with a large dark brown leather-looking shoulder bag carried at the side on a gold chain strap, gold-toned rings, a bracelet or watch stack at the wrist, and statement earrings, giving the outfit a refined editorial mood with vintage newspaper graphics, tactile collar trim, and ornate accessory accents.
